constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (revision_id) REFERENCES article_revisions(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

indexes.name: article_media_one_hero_per_revision_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX article_media_one_hero_per_revision_idx ON public.article_media USING btree (revision_id) WHERE (role = 'hero'::media_role)

indexes.name: article_media_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX article_media_pkey ON public.article_media USING btree (id)

indexes.name: article_media_revision_role_position_unique

policies.using_expression:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM articles a

triggers.name: article_media_immutable

tables.name: article_revisions
tables.description: Immutable snapshots of all reader-visible article content and deterministic metadata.

columns.name: supersedes_revision_id

columns.name: content_checksum
columns.description: Generated SHA-256 fingerprint of title, dek, and canonical Markdown.

constraints.name: article_revisions_article_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (article_id) REFERENCES articles(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: article_revisions_supersedes_revision_id_fkey

indexes.name: article_revisions_article_created_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX article_revisions_article_created_idx ON public.article_revisions USING btree (article_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: article_revisions_article_number_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX article_revisions_article_number_unique ON public.article_revisions USING btree (article_id, revision_number)

indexes.name: article_revisions_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX article_revisions_pkey ON public.article_revisions USING btree (id)

indexes.name: article_revisions_supersedes_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX article_revisions_supersedes_idx ON public.article_revisions USING btree (supersedes_revision_id) WHERE (supersedes_revision_id IS NOT NULL)

policies.name: article_revisions_public_select
policies.using_expression:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM articles a
  WHERE ((a.published_revision_id = article_revisions.id) AND (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['published_pending_verification'::article_status, 'published'::article_status])))))

triggers.name: article_revisions_assign_number

tables.name: article_tags
tables.description: Many-to-many relationship between stable articles and discovery tags.

constraints.name: article_tags_article_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (article_id) REFERENCES articles(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: article_tags_tag_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES tags(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

indexes.name: article_tags_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX article_tags_pkey ON public.article_tags USING btree (article_id, tag_id)

indexes.name: article_tags_tag_article_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX article_tags_tag_article_idx ON public.article_tags USING btree (tag_id, article_id)

policies.name: article_tags_public_select
policies.using_expression:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (articles a
     JOIN tags t ON ((t.id = article_tags.tag_id)))
  WHERE ((a.id = article_tags.article_id) AND (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['published_pending_verification'::article_status, 'published'::article_status])) AND t.is_active)))

triggers.name: article_tags_audit
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER article_tags_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON article_tags FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.audit_mutation()

tables.name: articles
tables.description: Stable article identities and lifecycle pointers. Reader-visible content always comes from published_revision_id.

columns.name: canonical_path
columns.description: Derived /{pillar}/{slug} path maintained by a trigger.

columns.name: revision_counter
columns.description: Atomic per-article sequence source for immutable revision numbers.

columns.name: row_version
columns.description: Optimistic-concurrency token incremented on meaningful article updates.

constraints.name: articles_archive_state_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = 'archived'::article_status AND archived_at IS NOT NULL OR status <> 'archived'::article_status)

constraints.name: articles_publication_dates_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (first_published_at IS NULL OR last_published_at IS NULL OR first_published_at <= last_published_at)

constraints.name: articles_schedule_state_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = 'scheduled'::article_status AND scheduled_for IS NOT NULL OR status <> 'scheduled'::article_status)

constraints.name: articles_author_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES authors(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: articles_category_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: articles_current_draft_revision_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (current_draft_revision_id) REFERENCES article_revisions(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: articles_primary_pillar_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (primary_pillar_id) REFERENCES pillars(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: articles_published_revision_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (published_revision_id) REFERENCES article_revisions(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

indexes.name: articles_author_status_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX articles_author_status_idx ON public.articles USING btree (author_id, status, last_published_at DESC)

indexes.name: articles_canonical_path_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX articles_canonical_path_unique ON public.articles USING btree (canonical_path)

indexes.name: articles_category_status_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX articles_category_status_idx ON public.articles USING btree (category_id, status, last_published_at DESC) WHERE (category_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: articles_current_draft_revision_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX articles_current_draft_revision_unique ON public.articles USING btree (current_draft_revision_id)

indexes.name: articles_pillar_status_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX articles_pillar_status_idx ON public.articles USING btree (primary_pillar_id, status, last_published_at DESC)

indexes.name: articles_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX articles_pkey ON public.articles USING btree (id)

indexes.name: articles_published_revision_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX articles_published_revision_unique ON public.articles USING btree (published_revision_id)

indexes.name: articles_status_published_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX articles_status_published_idx ON public.articles USING btree (status, last_published_at DESC) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['published_pending_verification'::article_status, 'published'::article_status]))

triggers.name: articles_audit
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER articles_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON articles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.audit_mutation()

triggers.name: articles_record_path_history
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER articles_record_path_history AFTER UPDATE OF canonical_slug, primary_pillar_id ON articles FOR EACH ROW WHEN (old.canonical_path IS DISTINCT FROM new.canonical_path) EXECUTE FUNCTION private.record_article_path_history()

triggers.name: articles_refresh_search
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER articles_refresh_search AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON articles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.refresh_search_from_article()

triggers.name: articles_set_and_validate_path
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER articles_set_and_validate_path BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF canonical_slug, primary_pillar_id, category_id ON articles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.set_and_validate_article_path()

triggers.name: articles_set_update_metadata
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER articles_set_update_metadata BEFORE UPDATE ON articles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.set_article_update_metadata()

triggers.name: articles_validate_revision_pointers
triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER articles_validate_revision_pointers AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF current_draft_revision_id, published_revision_id, status, first_published_at, last_published_at ON articles DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.validate_article_revision_pointers()

tables.name: citations
tables.description: Ordered links from an immutable revision to normalized sources, with public locator/quotation data.

constraints.name: citations_revision_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (revision_id) REFERENCES article_revisions(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: citations_source_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (source_id) REFERENCES sources(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

indexes.name: citations_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX citations_pkey ON public.citations USING btree (id)

indexes.name: citations_revision_key_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX citations_revision_key_unique ON public.citations USING btree (revision_id, citation_key)

indexes.name: citations_revision_ordinal_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX citations_revision_ordinal_unique ON public.citations USING btree (revision_id, ordinal)

indexes.name: citations_revision_public_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX citations_revision_public_idx ON public.citations USING btree (revision_id, ordinal) WHERE is_public

indexes.name: citations_source_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX citations_source_idx ON public.citations USING btree (source_id)

policies.name: citations_public_select
policies.using_expression:
(is_public AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM articles a
  WHERE ((a.published_revision_id = citations.revision_id) AND (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['published_pending_verification'::article_status, 'published'::article_status]))))))

triggers.name: citations_audit
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER citations_audit AFTER INSERT ON citations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.audit_mutation()

tables.name: featured_collection_items
tables.description: Ordered many-to-many placement of articles inside featured collections.

constraints.name: featured_collection_items_article_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (article_id) REFERENCES articles(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: featured_collection_items_collection_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (collection_id) REFERENCES featured_collections(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: featured_collection_items_article_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX featured_collection_items_article_idx ON public.featured_collection_items USING btree (article_id, collection_id)

indexes.name: featured_collection_items_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX featured_collection_items_pkey ON public.featured_collection_items USING btree (collection_id, article_id)

indexes.name: featured_collection_items_position_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX featured_collection_items_position_unique ON public.featured_collection_items USING btree (collection_id, "position")

policies.name: featured_collection_items_public_select
policies.using_expression:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (featured_collections fc
     JOIN articles a ON ((a.id = featured_collection_items.article_id)))
  WHERE ((fc.id = featured_collection_items.collection_id) AND (fc.status = 'published'::collection_status) AND ((fc.starts_at IS NULL) OR (fc.starts_at <= clock_timestamp())) AND ((fc.ends_at IS NULL) OR (fc.ends_at > clock_timestamp())) AND (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['published_pending_verification'::article_status, 'published'::article_status])))))

triggers.name: featured_collection_items_audit
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER featured_collection_items_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON featured_collection_items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.audit_mutation()

tables.name: featured_collections
tables.description: Founder-curated, optionally time-bounded editorial groupings used by the homepage and collection pages.

constraints.name: featured_collections_window_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (starts_at IS NULL OR ends_at IS NULL OR starts_at < ends_at)

indexes.name: featured_collections_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX featured_collections_pkey ON public.featured_collections USING btree (id)

indexes.name: featured_collections_public_window_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX featured_collections_public_window_idx ON public.featured_collections USING btree (status, starts_at, ends_at) WHERE (status = 'published'::collection_status)

indexes.name: featured_collections_slug_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX featured_collections_slug_key ON public.featured_collections USING btree (slug)

policies.name: featured_collections_public_select
policies.using_expression: ((status = 'published'::collection_status) AND ((starts_at IS NULL) OR (starts_at <= clock_timestamp())) AND ((ends_at IS NULL) OR (ends_at > clock_timestamp())))

triggers.name: featured_collections_audit
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER featured_collections_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON featured_collections FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.audit_mutation()

triggers.name: featured_collections_set_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER featured_collections_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON featured_collections FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.set_updated_at()

tables.name: media_assets
tables.description: Private master asset metadata, provenance, rights, focal point, and processing state.

columns.name: original_storage_key
columns.description: Logical key in the private media-originals bucket; never exposed through public views.

columns.name: checksum_sha256
columns.description: Lowercase SHA-256 checksum of original bytes for integrity and deduplication.

constraints.name: media_assets_dimensions_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (width IS NULL AND height IS NULL OR width > 0 AND height > 0)

constraints.name: media_assets_focal_x_range
constraints.definition: CHECK (focal_x IS NULL OR focal_x >= 0::numeric AND focal_x <= 1::numeric)

constraints.name: media_assets_focal_y_range
constraints.definition: CHECK (focal_y IS NULL OR focal_y >= 0::numeric AND focal_y <= 1::numeric)

indexes.name: media_assets_checksum_unique_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX media_assets_checksum_unique_idx ON public.media_assets USING btree (checksum_sha256, byte_size)

indexes.name: media_assets_original_storage_key_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX media_assets_original_storage_key_key ON public.media_assets USING btree (original_storage_key)

indexes.name: media_assets_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX media_assets_pkey ON public.media_assets USING btree (id)

indexes.name: media_assets_processing_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX media_assets_processing_idx ON public.media_assets USING btree (processing_status, created_at) WHERE (processing_status <> 'ready'::media_processing_status)

policies.name: media_assets_public_select
policies.using_expression:
((processing_status = 'ready'::media_processing_status) AND (rights_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unknown'::media_rights_status, 'restricted'::media_rights_status])) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (article_media am
     JOIN articles a ON ((a.published_revision_id = am.revision_id)))
  WHERE ((am.media_asset_id = media_assets.id) AND (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['published_pending_verification'::article_status, 'published'::article_status]))))))

triggers.name: media_assets_audit
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER media_assets_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON media_assets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.audit_mutation()

triggers.name: media_assets_set_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER media_assets_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON media_assets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.set_updated_at()

tables.name: media_variants
tables.description: Pre-generated immutable delivery variants. Public variants map to media-public Storage objects.

constraints.name: media_variants_dimensions_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (width IS NULL AND height IS NULL OR width > 0 AND height > 0)

constraints.name: media_variants_media_asset_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (media_asset_id) REFERENCES media_assets(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

indexes.name: media_variants_asset_name_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX media_variants_asset_name_unique ON public.media_variants USING btree (media_asset_id, variant_name)

indexes.name: media_variants_asset_public_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX media_variants_asset_public_idx ON public.media_variants USING btree (media_asset_id, variant_name) WHERE is_public

indexes.name: media_variants_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX media_variants_pkey ON public.media_variants USING btree (id)

indexes.name: media_variants_storage_key_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX media_variants_storage_key_key ON public.media_variants USING btree (storage_key)

policies.name: media_variants_public_select
policies.using_expression:
(is_public AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM media_assets ma
  WHERE ((ma.id = media_variants.media_asset_id) AND (ma.processing_status = 'ready'::media_processing_status) AND (ma.rights_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unknown'::media_rights_status, 'restricted'::media_rights_status])) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM (article_media am
             JOIN articles a ON ((a.published_revision_id = am.revision_id)))
          WHERE ((am.media_asset_id = ma.id) AND (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['published_pending_verification'::article_status, 'published'::article_status])))))))))

triggers.name: media_variants_audit
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER media_variants_audit AFTER INSERT ON media_variants FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.audit_mutation()

triggers.name: media_variants_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER media_variants_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON media_variants FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.prevent_update_or_delete()

constraints.name: publication_events_publication_job_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (publication_job_id) REFERENCES publication_jobs(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

indexes.name: publication_events_job_sequence_unique

views.name: published_articles
views.description: Safe published article read model; excludes drafts, internal fields, and body_plain_text.
views.definition:
SELECT a.id,
    a.canonical_slug,
    a.canonical_path,
    a.first_published_at,
    a.last_published_at,
    r.id AS revision_id,
    r.title,
    r.dek,
    r.body_markdown,
    r.word_count,
    r.reading_time_minutes,
    r.seo_title,
    r.seo_description,
    r.social_title,
    r.social_description,
    r.content_checksum,
    au.id AS author_id,
    au.name AS author_name,
    au.slug AS author_slug,
    p.id AS pillar_id,
    p.name AS pillar_name,
    p.slug AS pillar_slug,
    c.id AS category_id,
    c.name AS category_name,
    c.slug AS category_slug,
    COALESCE(( SELECT array_agg(t.name ORDER BY t.name) AS array_agg
           FROM article_tags atg
             JOIN tags t ON t.id = atg.tag_id
          WHERE atg.article_id = a.id AND t.is_active), '{}'::text[]) AS tags
   FROM articles a
     JOIN article_revisions r ON r.id = a.published_revision_id
     JOIN authors au ON au.id = a.author_id AND au.is_active
     JOIN pillars p ON p.id = a.primary_pillar_id AND p.is_active
     LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = a.category_id AND c.is_active
  WHERE a.status = ANY (ARRAY['published_pending_verification'::article_status, 'published'::article_status]);

views.name: published_citations
views.description: Public citation snapshots and safe source metadata for currently published revisions.
views.definition:
SELECT c.id,
    a.id AS article_id,
    c.revision_id,
    c.ordinal,
    c.citation_key,
    c.citation_text,
    c.locator,
    c.public_note,
    c.quoted_text,
    s.id AS source_id,
    s.source_type,
    s.title AS source_title,
    s.author_text,
    s.publisher,
    s.publication_date,
    s.url,
    s.archive_url,
    s.isbn,
    s.doi,
    s.accessed_at
   FROM citations c
     JOIN articles a ON a.published_revision_id = c.revision_id
     JOIN sources s ON s.id = c.source_id
  WHERE (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['published_pending_verification'::article_status, 'published'::article_status])) AND c.is_public;

views.name: published_featured_collections
views.definition:
SELECT fc.id,
    fc.name,
    fc.slug,
    fc.description,
    fci."position",
    fci.label,
    pa.id AS article_id,
    pa.canonical_path,
    pa.title,
    pa.dek,
    pa.pillar_name,
    pa.category_name,
    pa.first_published_at
   FROM featured_collections fc
     JOIN featured_collection_items fci ON fci.collection_id = fc.id
     JOIN published_articles pa ON pa.id = fci.article_id
  WHERE fc.status = 'published'::collection_status AND (fc.starts_at IS NULL OR fc.starts_at <= clock_timestamp()) AND (fc.ends_at IS NULL OR fc.ends_at > clock_timestamp());

views.name: published_media
views.description: Public derivative metadata only; Storage object paths are resolved only by the privileged public-media signer.
views.definition:
SELECT am.id AS article_media_id,
    a.id AS article_id,
    am.revision_id,
    am.role,
    am."position",
    COALESCE(am.alt_text, ma.default_alt_text) AS alt_text,
    COALESCE(am.caption, ma.default_caption) AS caption,
    COALESCE(am.credit_override, ma.credit_text) AS credit_text,
    ma.id AS media_asset_id,
    ma.kind,
    ma.width AS original_width,
    ma.height AS original_height,
    ma.focal_x,
    ma.focal_y,
    mv.id AS variant_id,
    mv.variant_name,
    mv.mime_type,
    mv.format,
    mv.width,
    mv.height,
    mv.byte_size,
    mv.checksum_sha256
   FROM article_media am
     JOIN articles a ON a.published_revision_id = am.revision_id
     JOIN authors au ON au.id = a.author_id AND au.is_active
     JOIN pillars p ON p.id = a.primary_pillar_id AND p.is_active
     JOIN media_assets ma ON ma.id = am.media_asset_id
     JOIN media_variants mv ON mv.media_asset_id = ma.id AND mv.is_public
  WHERE (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['published_pending_verification'::article_status, 'published'::article_status])) AND ma.processing_status = 'ready'::media_processing_status AND (ma.rights_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unknown'::media_rights_status, 'restricted'::media_rights_status]));
